entities.name: RibBA
observations: 400-aa query has 61.5–64.3% identity and 97.8–98.5% query coverage to reviewed RibBA homologs; annotation is moderate homology support.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 3.5.4.25 and EC 4.1.99.12 activities in riboflavin biosynthesis.

entities.name: Ribulose-5-P to DHBP
observations: RibBA homolog annotations assign conversion of D-ribulose 5-phosphate to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate (DHBP) and formate; EC 4.1.99.12; Rhea RHEA:18457.

entities.name: GTP to DARP
observations: RibBA homolog annotations assign GTP conversion to 2,5-diamino-6-ribosylamino-4(3H)-pyrimidinone 5'-phosphate (DARP), formate and pyrophosphate; EC 3.5.4.25; Rhea RHEA:23704.
